entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: A Rakdos bloodwitch who was acting Guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos for a few hundred years.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon who leads the Cult of Rakdos, slumbering in a lava pit in Rix Maadi, whose mind is split after Izolda's ritual.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The guild whose acting Guildmaster Izolda was.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: Place with the lava pit where Rakdos slumbers.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A figure who provided draconic cerebral fluid and planned to defeat Rakdos with Project Kraj; killed by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Myc Savo Zunich
entities.description: Son of Jarad and Fonn, whose blood was used and who ended up sharing a mind with Rakdos.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: The Golgari guildmaster and father of Myc, killed by Izolda.

entities.name: Fonn
entities.description: A ledev guard and mother of Myc.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A figure who killed Momir Vig.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Vig's construct in which Rakdos was trapped.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The period during which Izolda tried to raise and control Rakdos.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: An event after which Izolda died.

entities.name: Cory Herndon
entities.description: Author who explained the names Izolda and Lyzolda.

events.summary: Izolda holds the mantle of acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos Cult for a few hundred years until her death after the Decamillennial.
events.quote: The bloodwitch Izolda held the mantle of acting Guildmaster for a few hundred years

events.summary: Izolda tries to raise and control Rakdos using draconic cerebral fluid from Momir Vig and Myc's blood; Myc's parents unintentionally disrupt the spell, joining Myc's and Rakdos's minds.
events.quote: resulted in a shared mind between Myc and Rakdos instead

events.summary: Izolda finishes the ritual by killing Jarad and taking control of Rakdos.
events.quote: Izolda finished the ritual by killing Jarad and taking control of Rakdos herself.

events.summary: Vig is killed by Agrus Kos and Rakdos is trapped within Kraj, suffering extensive damage.
events.quote: Vig was killed by Agrus Kos

events.summary: Izolda suffers the spell's backlash and her cult members tear her apart to feast on her flesh; Rakdos's mind is split among them and he falls into a coma.
events.quote: her fellow cult members saw her moment of weakness and tore her limb from limb to feast on her flesh

relations.quote: The bloodwitch Izolda held the mantle of acting Guildmaster

relations.note: killed him to finish the ritual
relations.quote: Izolda finished the ritual by killing Jarad
Vig was killed by Agrus Kos
the son of the Golgari guildmaster Jarad and the ledev guard Fonn

relations.note: planned to defeat him with Project Kraj
relations.quote: Vig knew her plans and had planned to use Project Kraj to defeat Rakdos
